question.problem:
Consider the change of variables given by the matrix equation

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{5} & \frac{4}{5} \\ \frac{4}{5} & \frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}],
$$

and the curve $C,$ defined as

$$
C:\,9{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+16{x}_{2}^{2}-50{x}_{1}+25{x}_{2}=0.
$$

 

Given that the change of variables above reduces $Q(x)=9{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+16{x}_{2}^{2}$ to its canonical (diagonal) form $25{y}_{1}^{2}$ what type of a quadratic curve is defined by $C?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we note the following:

$$
C:\,{{9{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+16{x}_{2}^{2}}_{⏟}}_{Q(x)}-50{x}_{1}+25{x}_{2}=0
$$

Let's write the given change of variables explicitly:

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{5} & \frac{4}{5} \\ \frac{4}{5} & \frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]\,⟹\,\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=\frac{4}{5}{y}_{2}-\frac{3}{5}{y}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}=\frac{4}{5}{y}_{1}+\frac{3}{5}{y}_{2},\end{aligned}
$$

We know that the given change of variables reduces $Q(x)$ to its canonical form. Therefore, performing the change of variables on $C,$ we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}9{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+16{x}_{2}^{2}-50{x}_{1}+25{x}_{2} & =0 \\ 25{y}_{1}^{2}-50(\frac{4}{5}{y}_{2}-\frac{3}{5}{y}_{1})+25(\frac{4}{5}{y}_{1}+\frac{3}{5}{y}_{2}) & =0 \\ 25{y}_{1}^{2}+50{y}_{1}-25{y}_{2} & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, we complete the square for the variable ${y}_{1}:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}25{y}_{1}^{2}+50{y}_{1}-25{y}_{2} & =0 \\ {y}_{1}^{2}+2{y}_{1}-{y}_{2} & =0 \\ {y}_{1}^{2}+2{y}_{1}+1-1-{y}_{2} & =0 \\ ({y}_{1}+1)^{2}-1-{y}_{2} & =0 \\ ({y}_{1}+1)^{2} & ={y}_{2}+1\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, performing the change of variables 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{z}_{1}={y}_{1}+1, \\ {z}_{2}={y}_{2}+1,\end{aligned}
$$

we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}({y}_{1}+1)^{2} & ={y}_{2}+1 \\ {z}_{1}^{2} & ={z}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

This represents a parabola that opens in the direction of the positive ${z}_{2}$-axis.
